bomb._comment: statBaselineByCmc computed from combined creature pool across ecl/fin/hob/msh/stx/tmt (build-bomb-baseline.mjs) — refresh as more sets get cached. Shared across all sets on purpose so bomb scores stay on the same scale set-to-set, rather than each set grading against its own curve.

removal._comment: Weights halved vs. their original 4/6/5/8/8/3 values to bring removal's typical score onto the same scale as bomb — see refactor.md discussion. Relative ranking (exile > destroy > board wipe > temp exile > -X/-X) is unchanged. fight/damage/lockdown added later — flat weights, not scaled by the actual damage/counter amount printed, consistent with how -X/-X already treats every magnitude the same.

patterns.note: temporary exile — reversible, weakest of the three
board wipe — strong but not targeted
permanent exile — strongest, skip if already matched exile-until-leaves
fight — conditional removal, needs your own creature already in play and risks it
damage-based removal (burn) — conditional on the target's toughness
flexible burn — can remove a small creature or go to the face; also see aggro's matching pattern
Pacifism-style lockdown — permanent and doesn't require your own creature, but leaves the creature on board

aggro._comment: Weights doubled vs. their original 2/2/1 + 2/1/2/1 values — the old max (3) barely cleared tagThreshold, so almost nothing tagged aggro. Now on the same scale as bomb/removal/evasion.

patterns.note: reach — can also go to the face; matching pattern in removal covers the creature-facing read
permanent pump via counters — same weight as the temporary 'gets +X/+X' pattern

diversity._comment: Weights scaled 1.5x vs. their original 2/1/2/1.5 values for the same reason as aggro — bring the typical/max score onto the shared bomb/removal/evasion scale. Covers the full 'advantage in any form' bucket — draw, ramp, scry/surveil, tokens, life gain, graveyard recursion — deliberately excluding strategy-specific value like discard/mill/drain.
